definition: The distinctive clothing worn by members of the same organization.
exampleSentence: Students must wear their school uniform during exams.

definition: A hard or padded protective hat.
exampleSentence: Cyclists have to wear a safety helmet on the road.
You must ask for permission before leaving the room.

definition: The condition of being protected from or unlikely to cause danger.
exampleSentence: Workers have to follow all workplace safety rules.
I must make an urgent phone call before boarding.

definition: To comply with commands or laws.
exampleSentence: All motorists must obey the road speed limits.

definition: To formally forbid something by authority.
exampleSentence: Smoking is prohibited inside the library building.

definition: To give authorization or consent to someone.
exampleSentence: Visitors must obtain a permit before entering.

definition: To have on one's body as clothing.
exampleSentence: Students have to wear school uniforms every day.

definition: To write one's name on a formal document.
exampleSentence: You have to sign your name at the bottom of the form.
